changelog: The safer navigation choice now summons a full-screen applause storm: color emojis fall under gravity, bounce, and collide instead of hiding in a tiny toast.
Devices with a vibrator may add a short haptic applause; unsupported devices remain safely silent without blocking the reward.
Navigation labels now escape clipped parent containers after refreshes, keeping custom names readable.
The wooden navigation tale has been simplified into more than fifty tiny pages, so JinDevil's legendary mistake can be survived one click at a time.
Per-tab colors now retry after CloudStream refreshes its menu, while the emoji mode keeps its color instead of accepting the white-silhouette curse.
The wise choice still earns applause and fireworks; the suspicious ship-wheel decoration has been removed.
The navigation bar now applauds anyone who refuses to repeat JinDevil's legendary mistake.
Per-tab colors have escaped the shared tint spell, while emoji icons are once again allowed to keep their actual colors.
The navigation tale has been rebuilt as a dusty fairy story with crooked wood, cobwebs, and a familiar restart button.
The old dialogs have vanished; four new chapters remember JinDevil's settings-cog incident and the legendary question about reverting back.
Rewrote the classified navigation incident with more jokes, fewer innocent checkboxes, and questionable snack logistics.
A classified navigation incident is now sealed behind four chapters. The name has been redacted.
The old warning has learned to tell a story. There may be a familiar name hidden between the lines.
Added an English attention banner before hiding Home or Settings navigation tabs.
The attention banner updates live when essential tabs are selected.
Added a fun safety warning before hiding Home or Settings navigation tabs.
Hiding both Home and Settings now requires an explicit confirmation.
Navigation Text Only now supports label case selection and adjustable letter spacing.
Text Only appearance now supports live preview, custom font families, and label sizing.
Navigation Text Only supports a 6-16sp size slider with half-step precision and live preview.
Navigation Text Only supports Default, Sans Serif, Serif, and Monospace font families.
Navigation Text Only now renders theme-colored, size-adaptive labels reliably.
Navigation supports custom tab labels and independent per-tab icon colors.
Navigation style switching restores the original CloudStream icons safely.
Player control injection now fails closed until CloudStream's dedicated player_lock_holder is ready; unsafe generic control-row fallbacks were removed.
Default CS3M activation no longer changes CloudStream's player timeout or speed controls.
External downloader injection points are explicit opt-ins and are never enabled automatically.
message: v723 - full-screen applause rain, haptics, and unclipped navigation labels
